title: Nondeterministic oracle table
statement: Define a nondeterministic oracle Turing machine with no ordinary work tapes, Boolean symbols, and four states numbered $0,1,2,3$. Its initial state is $0$, its query state is $1$, and its positive and negative answer states are $2$ and $3$. In state $0$, on input symbol $1$, it nondeterministically writes its choice bit to the query tape, moves right, and remains in state $0$; on input symbol $0$, it takes the negative-answer action. On a blank input cell it moves right and enters the query state. In state $2$ it takes the positive-answer action, and in every other state it takes the negative-answer action.
caveat: The referenced positive- and negative-answer actions are not defined in the supplied snippet, so their precise tape and head effects cannot be stated here.
